## Context
Child of epic 5c34-4343-a3e6-4ad5 (WA discovery questions). Phase 1: assemble the two evidence bases into the deliverable skeleton at `docs/analysis/wa-discovery-questions-2026-08.md`.

## Plan
Create the deliverable skeleton with an Evidence base section synthesizing: (1) WA knowns/unknowns — docs/references/washington/ (40-doc corpus, FINDINGS.md, manifest.json), samples/washington/ (5 CIO memos + statements.json labeled assumptions), samples/washington-validation/coverage-report.md (interview-only unknowns: parallel-run-appetite, change-freeze-feasibility, writeback-burden-profile, team-cost-rate, savings-descope-lag), and the Kehoe actual-buyer eval's six hard conditions (evaluations/virtual-cio/evaluation-wa-report/findings.md: priced contraction scenario, expired M&O decomposition-window decision, tested write-back seam, WAHBE written memorandum, cost attribution/sensitivity, current ACES ICD); (2) failure/success corpus index — docs/references/georgia (contract 2014035 amendments 10–25 buy-path drift), vermont (no-prime-vendor exit trap), newyork (expired-vendor cliff / terminated IES), arizona (halted retirement, renewal exposure), docs/references/methodology + external/modernization, and evaluations/virtual-cio/cross-state-findings.md systemic gaps. Cite only Citable sources per docs/source-policy.md; internal-context material informs but is never named.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Deliverable skeleton exists: `test -f docs/analysis/wa-discovery-questions-2026-08.md`
- [ ] Evidence base section present with both subsections: `grep -q '^## Evidence base' docs/analysis/wa-discovery-questions-2026-08.md && grep -q 'What Washington' docs/analysis/wa-discovery-questions-2026-08.md`
- [ ] The six buyer-eval hard conditions are enumerated: `grep -q 'contraction scenario' docs/analysis/wa-discovery-questions-2026-08.md && grep -q 'decomposition window' docs/analysis/wa-discovery-questions-2026-08.md && grep -q 'ACES ICD' docs/analysis/wa-discovery-questions-2026-08.md`
- [ ] The five interview-only unknowns are enumerated: `grep -q 'parallel-run-appetite' docs/analysis/wa-discovery-questions-2026-08.md && grep -q 'savings-descope-lag' docs/analysis/wa-discovery-questions-2026-08.md`
- [ ] Failure-corpus index names all four comparator states: `grep -q 'Georgia' docs/analysis/wa-discovery-questions-2026-08.md && grep -q 'Vermont' docs/analysis/wa-discovery-questions-2026-08.md && grep -q 'New York' docs/analysis/wa-discovery-questions-2026-08.md && grep -q 'Arizona' docs/analysis/wa-discovery-questions-2026-08.md`

## Testing
Deterministic grep/test commands above from repo root on branch feat/wa-discovery-questions. Docs-only; no build. Source-policy compliance reviewed at PR (rebar code-review gate).
